title: Straightforward Intake — Work-Related Stress
description: Clear presenting concern, consistent answers, all major areas covered

conversation.content: Thank you for reaching out. Could you start by telling me what brings you here today?
I've been really struggling with stress at work. My new manager is very demanding and I've been feeling overwhelmed for about three months now.
I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about how this stress is affecting you day to day?
I'm not sleeping well — maybe 5 hours a night when I used to get 8. I feel tired all the time, I've lost my appetite, and I find it hard to concentrate at work, which makes things even worse.
That sounds really difficult. Has this affected your relationships or activities outside of work?
Yes, I've been withdrawing from friends. I used to go out on weekends but I've cancelled plans the last four or five weeks. I just don't have the energy.
Thank you for sharing that. I want to ask about your wellbeing more broadly — have you had any thoughts of harming yourself or not wanting to be here?
No, nothing like that. I just want to feel like myself again. I have my family around me and they're supportive.
That's helpful to know. Have you sought any support before, or are you currently taking any medications?
I've never spoken to a therapist before. No medications. This is the first time I've reached out for help.
Is there anything specific you're hoping to get out of speaking with someone?
I want to learn how to manage stress better and get my sleep back to normal. I'd like to feel less overwhelmed.
